description.en-US: C. C. J. Webb's English (Methuen, Library of Devotion, 1903) of a selection from Anselm's Orationes sive meditationes: his preface, Meditations I-IV and four prayers, with five letters of spiritual counsel. Webb's selection and numbering differ from the Latin book, so it is a separate book of the same work.
description.pt-BR: A tradução inglesa de C. C. J. Webb (1903) de uma seleção das orações e meditações de Anselmo, com cinco cartas de direção espiritual.

sources.edition: The Devotions of Saint Anselm, Archbishop of Canterbury, edited by Clement C. J. Webb (London: Methuen, 1903).
sources.description: Djvu OCR cleaned by script, not proofread. The Proslogion, Webb's introduction and note on its argument are not imported (the Proslogion is in its own book). Webb's footnotes are kept as footnotes where the OCR keeps the markers legible and dropped otherwise; the drop capitals the OCR lost at the head of each piece are restored by hand.
sources.tierEvidence: Published in 1903, before 1931: public domain in the US.
